_note: The walkthrough's fallback sample, for a brand without its own (brands/<id>/tutorial/sample.json). Fictional organization, people and figures.
title: How Harbor Point got its afternoons back
prompt: Draft this into a two-page case study sheet for operations leaders. The organization, people and figures are illustrative. End on a demo invite.

answers.images: No images: use the brand library or the test image

start: Read the notes and spot what shouldn't go out as written
interview: Skip a question: every one is optional
draft: Find where a number in the draft came from in claims.md
proof: Change the headline to "How Harbor Point won back its afternoons"
Reply to one of the Check comments
design: Drag the field technician's quote above the results chart
export: Ask for a print version on white
formats: Ask for another format, such as social posts
revise: Say "the 41% should be 38%" and watch it change in every output

more.prompt: Also make a PowerPoint deck from the same words, for a board meeting.
Also make a LinkedIn carousel of the results.
Also make a 15-second animated film of the results for Instagram stories.
Also make two social posts and a story with captions.
Also make an HTML email announcing the case study to partners.
